errors.evidence: The description incorrectly says that the Y-axis has visible labels. The axis actually has labels but does not explicitly mention that the values are presented in values lower (negative) than -10.00%.
The description fails to mention that the X-axis has no numeric labels or visible divisions.
The description does not mention the presence of horizontal grid lines on the charts.
The description fails to explain the overall purpose of the figure, which is a comparative analysis.
